generated_by: phase2/135-d01 manual audit from committed manifests, docs/data-sources/d01-terrain.json, pipelines/coarse manifests and repository tests
scope_statement: Body x terrain-feature coverage matrix for D01. This is a measured inventory of committed/indexed/queryable support and verified blockers in this repository state; it is not a claim of global, exhaustive, or scientifically comparable cross-body terrain coverage.

fine_method.slope_method: Horn 3x3 over complete neighbourhoods in a projected body-fixed metric CRS
fine_method.roughness_method: standard deviation of plane-detrended residuals over valid cells
fine_method.flat_method: fraction of valid complete Horn-slope neighbourhoods with slope < 5 degrees
prohibited: Earth WGS84 or geographic-degree derivatives for Moon/Mars
upsampling coarse global DEMs into 90 m index support
treating pilot/item counts as area/global coverage

coarse_context_method.notes: Reuses merged #108/#97 coarse infrastructure. Earth coarse source is a preprocessed 250 m slope product; planetary coarse pilot uses Horn DEM derivatives at native/aggregated support and remains evidence_only/not_comparable. Cross-body ranking disabled.

entries.time_support: Static Copernicus DEM 2021 release; no seasonal/time series
entries.spatial_support: 1.98 km window, 22x22 cells at 90 m, bilinear resampling from 3 arc-second native grid
entries.crs: Source EPSG:4326; analysis in projected metric CRS per window extraction

Earth_fine.description: Read a real committed Earth fine-terrain candidate window with all five D01 metrics.
Earth_fine.example_record_selector: first candidate (e.g. earth-alps-r1c1) or any record in candidates[]
Earth_fine.reproducible_command:
python3 - <<'PY'
import json
m=json.load(open('pipelines/earth/manifests/copernicus_glo90_earth.json'))
c=m['candidates'][0]
print(c['location_id'], c['lat'], c['lon'], sorted(c['features'].keys()))
print({k:v['value'] for k,v in c['features'].items()})
PY
